product_metadata.title: Lightahead 7pcs Premium Rainbow Colored Knife Set, 6 Stainless Steel Kitchen Knives with Chopping Board
features: HIGH-QUALITY STAINLESS STEEL KITCHEN KNIFE SET - This fantastic 7-piece rainbow knife set consists of: 8" Chef Knife, 8" Bread Knife, 6.5" Santoku Knife, 5.5" Carving Knife, 5" Utility Knife, 3.5" Paring Knife, Chopping Board.

FEATURES- made from fine quality 2CR13 stainless steel giving the blade a smooth finish. The ergonomically designed Polypropylene (PP) handle fits perfectly into the curve of your hand, thus allowing comfort whilst cutting. Multiple Blade styles cut easily through a variety food items. Chopping Board is reversible for double the cutting surface and features a hand hole for added control and stability, and it Is Ideal for Cutting, Slicing and Chopping Meats, Poultry, Fish and Vegetables.

USES- Chef Knife for slicing, chopping, dicing, mincing, disjointing large cuts of meat. Bread Knife for slicing bread. Santoku Knife for cutting around the bone of meat, slicing roasts, large pieces of fish,salmon. Carving Knife: Oval cut-out design in blade reduces friction, keeps food from sticking. Utility Knife for cutting larger vegetables, sandwich meats, not large enough for a chef’s knife. Paring Knife for pairing and peeling vegetables, fruits.

KNIFE SET FEATURES - The Elegant And Beautifully Designed Rainbow Colored Knife Set. Cutting Edge Design Provides Less Friction While Slicing And Chopping, So Foods Stick Less. Special Design Handle Provides A Comfortable And Highly Controlled Grip. Odor-Resistant Poly Board Helps Knives Stay Sharp. Hand wash. Dish washer is not recommended, knife will become dull if use dishwasher. Do not use harsh scrubbers on the knife. Wipe Dry after washing.

UTILITY - A thoughtful gift idea for college grads, newlyweds, or anyone setting up a first-time kitchen. Just as useful for those who know their way around a kitchen as it is for newbie chefs just learning the ropes, the set offers the full range of cutlery needed to start slicing, dicing, and chopping away.
